info.name: M-Audio Xponent (custom)
info.author: Augusto Salazar; MIDI layout reference from Mixco (J.P. Bolivar Puente, GPLv3)
info.description: Torq Xponent: 2 decks, mixer, EQ kills, hotcues, loops, beatjump, scratch, FX, brake/spinback. Shift (green arrow) + jog browses the library; tapping the green arrow loads the selected track.
